headline: Nigerian Naira weakens slightly as FX turnover declines
summary: The Nigerian naira depreciated by 0.22% to close at N1,349 per dollar as reported foreign exchange turnover on the Nigerian Foreign Exchange Market slowed to $1.45 billion.
why: The Nigerian naira is the official currency of Africa's largest oil-producing economy, reflecting domestic foreign exchange market liquidity.

impacts.name: Nigerian Naira
impacts.why: Subdued foreign exchange turnover on the Nigerian Foreign Exchange Market drove a 0.22% depreciation of the currency.
